brief: Return a consecutive slice of an array or a string
description: This function extracts a consecutive slice of values from an array, or of code points from a string. For a string, or another value stored as UTF-8, the result is a string.

parameters.description: The array, or the string, to slice.
parameters.name: array

parameters.description: This is the zero based starting index. Use negative number to index from the end. If not specified, an index of 0 is assumed.
parameters.name: startIndex

parameters.description: This is the zero based ending index. If positive, this is one more than the index of the last value or code point to include. If negative, the index is from the end. If not specified, the slice is from startIndex up to and including the end.
parameters.name: endIndex

returns.description: For an array, a new array containing the selected values; it is an array<T> only if array is one, so values of another data type can be added to it. For a string, a string containing the selected code points.
